vercel.//: Auth via VERCEL_TOKEN env; teamId/projectId here or via VERCEL_TEAM_ID/VERCEL_PROJECT_ID.
vercel.//egress: L2+ needs skip-download env vars (see README checklist) — put them in .env / config env.

modal.//: Auth via ~/.modal.toml (default active profile) or MODAL_TOKEN_ID/MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET.

namespace.//: Auth via NAMESPACE_TOKEN env = single-line {"bearer_token":"nsrt_..."} from `nsc token create --output token` (grant instance create/get/list/wait/ssh/exec/refresh/destroy).

cloudrun.//: Uses active gcloud project if project omitted. Jobs model: fixed cpu/memory for all levels.
